loop: SENSE: detect gap, failure, or opportunity from standing work, incidents, or owner goals
REFLECT: classify failure family; generate competing hypotheses
CANDIDATE: isolated build in approved worktree (GREEN-B)
PROVE: Skill Lab staging + independent verification
REGISTER: publish to composite-skills registry with manifest/proof hashes
INVOKE: exact proven skill on fresh inputs
VERIFY: independent artifact hash/size check + immutable receipt
RESUME: return to interrupted owner objective
NEXT: select next highest-value eligible work
anti_patterns: Do not let the agent blindly self-upgrade OpenClaw (Finn: 70%+ break the install)
Do not install unvetted ClawHub skills (ClawHavoc: 80%+ malicious in audits)
Do not widen allowlist before first PASS
Do not reset history to solve budgets
Do not treat a model turn or queue write as an owner outcome
Do not manufacture fake work or fake proof
success_signals: fresh proven-skill invocations on new inputs
